conditions: A wrong breed means another egg, another Power Core and another 48 hours.
Two Chesa imprints make Chesa far likelier, not certain, and still cost an egg and a core.
Don't pick the Helminth cyst Drain option; it makes a Helminth Charger.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment. Mature the pup in the Incubator before missions.
A built Power Core is a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint, 100,000 credits and 8 hours a build.
bonuses: Chesa imprints trade: a mature Chesa makes up to two, 1.5 hours each. Empty templates come from a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint, 10,000 credits and 6 hours a build.
Its Chesa Claws level but give no Mastery.
